item.title: Journal Citation Indicator
item.description: We want to inform our readers and authors that last year, the Web of Science introduced a new metric called Journal Citation Indicator (JCI). The JCI is a measure of the average Category Normalized Citation Impact of citable items published by a journal over a recent three year period. According to the profile of our journal on the website of the Web of Science Group, in 2020, the Arme. J. Math. had JCI equal to 0.59. The editorial board of the Armen. J. item.title: Journal Citation Indicator Summary 2021
item.description: We want to inform our readers and authors that according to the Web of Science Journal Citation Indicator (JCI), the metric for 2021 is 0.66. Category Rank: 228/475Category Quartile: Q2 The Journal Citation Indicator is a new metric introduced by the Web of Science which measures the average Category Normalized Citation Impact (CNCI) of citable items (articles and reviews) published by a journal over a recent three-year period. For more information on journal metrics, please visit Index page.

item.title: Journal Impact Factor for the Armen. J. Math. is now available
item.description: Beginning with the current year's publication, a Journal Impact Factor (JIF)™ is presented for all journals listed in the Web of Science Core Collection™, encompassing the Arts and Humanities Citation Index (AHCI)™ as well as the multidisciplinary Emerging Sources Citation Index (ESCI)™. Since the Armenian Journal of Mathematics is covered by ESCI, it is now provided with the Impact Factor. item.title: Armenian Journal of Mathematics has been recognized as a Q3 journal in SJR
item.description: We are pleased to announce that the Armenian Journal of Mathematics has been recognized as a Q3 journal in Scimago Journal Rank (SJR). According to the latest SJR update, Armen. J. Math. has maintained its position in Q3 with an SJR score of 0.36. This is a significant achievement that reflects the hard work and dedication of our authors, reviewers, and editorial team. We continue to work towards further achievements.
